title: Jepchirchir *suspended* over EPO
hook: Olympic and world marathon champion provisionally banned by the AIU.

slides.label: What happened
slides.h: Peres Jepchirchir hit by a *provisional ban*
slides.c: The Athletics Integrity Unit announced on 23 Oct an EPO finding in an out-of-competition sample taken in Kenya. It is not a finding of guilt.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: The sample was taken before Sydney on 30 Aug. The win could be disqualified if the finding stands. She can request B sample analysis.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.c: She is the 2021 Olympic and 2025 world champion. Sydney organisers say a ban of 3+ months means a lifetime ban from all Majors.

facts.claim: AIU announced provisional suspension of Peres Jepchirchir on 23 Oct 2026 after EPO adverse analytical finding in an out-of-competition sample in Kenya

Provisional suspension, not a finding of guilt; sample taken before Sydney Marathon (30 Aug); win could be disqualified; B sample can be requested; WMM rule: 3+ month ban = lifetime ban from Majors; titles Olympic 2021, world 2025

caption:
NEWS: Jepchirchir provisionally suspended for EPO

As of 24 Oct, the Athletics Integrity Unit has provisionally suspended Olympic and world marathon champion Peres Jepchirchir after an EPO finding in an out-of-competition sample taken before the Sydney Marathon. It is not a finding of guilt; her Sydney win could be disqualified.

Source: CITIUS Mag, ABC News
